Hi Alejandro / Sophie,

Thanks again for the conversation earlier — great to hear about ApexWare's plan to run latency-sensitive LLM features for support automation. We'd love to run a short product demo of Redwood Dedicated and follow up with a technical deep-dive focused on GPU pool sizing and autoscaling for your workloads.

Two asks to start:
- Can you confirm which technical folks will join (infra/ML infra/security)?
- Which of these slots works for a 60–75 minute session (demo + deep-dive):
  * Tue Mar 2, 10:00–11:15 PT
  * Wed Mar 3, 13:00–14:15 PT
  * Thu Mar 4, 08:30–09:45 PT

If none of those work, happy to propose alternatives. I attached a one-pager on Redwood Dedicated for context. We can tailor the deep-dive agenda to cover pool sizing, autoscale policies, isolation (VPC/tenant), and model variants/quantization trade-offs.

Best,
Marissa Cole

marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0198

Marissa,

Thanks — Tue Mar 2 at 10:00 PT looks promising for us but Sophie and I need to confirm with our infra lead. Quick note: we'd like this to be more than a product demo. Specifically we want a technical architecture review that covers:
- pool sizing guidance for mixed small/large models (7B/70B),
- autoscaling behavior under burst (holiday campaigns),
- isolation guarantees (per-customer pools, VPC networking),
- failure modes & fallback strategies (model variant fallbacks).

Can you loop in the Redwood engineer/solutions architect who can speak to these topics? Also can you share a short pre-call questionnaire so we can gather throughput/seq-length metrics on our side?

— Alejandro

Dev / Vivek — Alejandro and Sophie at ApexWare want a technical architecture review that focuses on pool sizing, autoscaling under burst, tenant isolation options, and failure/fallback strategies. Proposed slot: Tue Mar 2, 10:00–11:15 PT (60–75m). Can you confirm availability?

Proposed agenda (draft):
1) 10m – quick customer context (ApexWare infra & goals)
2) 20m – Redwood Dedicated demo + architecture overview (runtime, pool model)
3) 30–35m – deep-dive: pool sizing heuristics, autoscale policies, isolation patterns, fallback/variants
4) 10m – action items & mutual next steps (PoC sizing, pilot timeline)

Attachments: dedicated-pool-sizing-draft.xlsx (template) and a short pre-call questionnaire we’d like ApexWare to fill out (see capacity-questions.md).

If Tue 10:00 PT doesn't work we can move to Wed Mar 3 13:00 PT.

Marissa / Alejandro — I can join Tue Mar 2 at 10:00 PT. Vivek, can you make it as well?

A few asks so we can make the session highly actionable: please share the following before the call if possible:
- expected steady-state QPS and 95th/99th percentile latency SLOs per route/model
- peak burst multiplier (e.g., 5x during campaigns) and typical burst duration
- model families/weights you plan to serve (e.g., Llama 2 7B, mix of 7B/30B/70B)
- typical sequence length distribution (p50/p90/p99 tokens) and percent of streaming sessions
- any compliance/isolation requirements (per-tenant pools, encryption/KMS, private VPC)

I attached a short checklist that outlines the pre-call artifacts we prefer; if you can drop metrics in the shared Drive folder (see calendar invite link), we’ll prepare a preliminary pool-sizing recommendation and suggested autoscale min/max/burst policies. On the call we’ll cover: pool sizing heuristics, continuous batching trade-offs, KV-cache sizing, and how we implement isolation for Dedicated customers.

Thanks — look forward to it.
— Dev
